jobs.description:
Business Analyst (Junior or Senior) — Ghent
 

Are you ready to learn fast and make a real impact, working side by side with a small, close-knit team in Ghent? At Corlutions, we've been helping companies grow with Odoo since 2019, and we're expanding our team to do even more of that.
 

 
 

About Corlutions
 

Corlutions is a digitalization partner for small and medium-sized enterprises, specializing in Odoo-based solutions that help organizations reduce costs and increase revenue. We work closely with clients across sectors like manufacturing, construction, wholesale, and finance — always living by our principle: "Together is better."
 

 
 

What is a Business Analyst at Corlutions?
 

As a Business Analyst, your mission is to help our clients optimize their business processes through smart, well-implemented software — primarily Odoo and Business Intelligence. You'll gather and document business requirements, and translate them into clear functional specifications that guide every project.
 

You'll work closely with clients to ensure optimal use of Odoo apps such as Accounting, Point of Sales, eCommerce, Manufacturing, Inventory, Projects, Websites, Sales and more. By diving into your client's needs and processes, and providing personalized training, you'll become the go-to expert for their management solutions.
 

In your first weeks, you'll get comprehensive training before jumping into your first projects — always with the support of your mentor and colleagues. As you gain experience, you'll gain autonomy too. Collaboration stays key throughout: you'll be in regular contact with clients, developers, and the internal team.
 

 
 

Responsibilities
 

Project Implementation (80%)
 
 

• Gain the trust of your customers 

• Analyse needs, gather and document requirements, and suggest and implement solutions (configuration, development and testing) 

• Provide training 

• Follow-up and communication about ongoing tasks  

Internal improvement (20%)
 
 

• Feedback to the internal team 

• Mentoring and training 

• Feedback for improvement  

Optional: support other domains such as marketing, HR and accounting at Corlutions (impacts the % split above).
 

 
 

What's great about the job?
 

Expect real responsibility from day one, in a friendly and open environment where you'll work both independently and collaboratively. You'll take on a variety of projects across different industries, broadening your experience along the way. As a bonus, you'll go through an in-depth training provided by Odoo.
 

 
 

What we offer
 
 

• Sponsored events — afterworks and team buildings 

• Trainings — a real learning and development program 

• Green coworking space — we work from Pentagon, a green coworking space surrounded by water in Ghent 

• Sport activity — play any sport with colleagues, the bill might be covered! 

• Eat & drink — fruit basket and coffee on the house  

 
 

Ready to start your adventure? Apply now

Must Have
 
 

• Bachelor or Master's degree 

• Fluent in English and Dutch 

• Strong analytical mindset, with an interest in business analysis 

• Good communication and negotiation skills 

• Autonomous, assertive & proactive 

• Affinity with the IT world, and interest in Odoo, ERP and Business Intelligence tools 

• Learn fast and have a "Can Do" attitude  

Nice to Have
 
 

• Background in Business Administration, Applied Economics, Civil Engineering, Computer Sciences, or Business Intelligence experience 

• Fluent in French 

• Experience across different domains (marketing, HR, accounting) is a plus 

• Technical knowledge (XML, Python, JS, SQL, programming)

Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

• Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.

• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.

• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.

• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.

Business Process Improvement

• Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.

• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.

• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.

Requirements Analysis

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.

• Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.

• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.

• Solution Development

Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

• Evaluate and implement solutions that support both current and future business needs.

• Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.

Commercial & Supplier Management

• Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.

• Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.

• Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.

 

Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams

• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.

• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.

• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.

• Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.

• Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.

• Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Builds strong working relationships and influences stakeholders at different levels.

• Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

• Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.

• Is fluent in English; knowloedge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

Come make the world and accelerate your success.
 

It takes great people to achieve greatness. People with a sense of purpose and integrity. People with a relentless pursuit of excellence. People who care about making things better For Those Who Make The World™. Sound like you? Join our top-notch team of approximately 43,500 diverse and high-performing professionals globally who are making their mark on some of the world’s most beloved brands, including DEWALT®, BLACK+DECKER®, CRAFTSMAN®, STANLEY®, CUB CADET®, and HUSTLER®.
 

The Job:
 

Join Stanley Black & Decker as our 
Benelux Payroll Specialist and play a key role in delivering accurate, timely, and compliant payroll across the Benelux region. As part of the 
GSS Stanley Black & Decker Payroll Team, you will be at the heart of daily payroll operations, working closely with internal stakeholders and external payroll providers to ensure a seamless employee experience. Reporting directly to the

What You’ll Do:
 
 

• Manage end-to-end payroll processing for the Benelux region, including onboarding, offboarding, and employee status changes.

• Prepare payroll payments, perform monthly checks, support reconciliations, and assist with year-end and audit activities. 

• Generate payroll reports and respond to payroll-related queries from employees, managers, and stakeholders. 

• Collaborate closely with external payroll providers, government agencies, and third-party vendors while supporting process improvements and documentation updates. 
 

• Solid knowledge and hands-on experience with Benelux payroll processes.(Belgium payroll knowledge is a non-negotiable). 

• Good working knowledge of Joint Committee’s (Paritair Comité’s). 

• Proficiency with SDWorx and E-blox payroll (required). 

• Experience with ADP Globalview/Workday (a plus). 

• Strong Excel skills (including vlookup and pivot tables). 

• Ability to multitask and meet deadlines. 

• Self-motivated, adaptable, and a team player. 

• Fluent in Dutch and English.

As a Process Assistant (PA) in the SEM Operations team, you will work hands-on with state-of-the-art inline SEM and XSEM tools to support high-quality wafer inspection, process monitoring, and operational excellence across the imec Fab.
 

What you will do 
 

Operational Excellence 
 
 

• Contribute to day-to-day operational readiness of SEM tools within a 24/7 production environment  

• Collaborate with First Line Support (FLS), Equipment, and Process Engineers to ensure tool availability, stability, and performance  

• Act as a technical bridge between Operations and Engineering to enable smooth coordination and handovers  

• Support cross-functional initiatives aimed at reducing cycle time and improving tool efficiency  

• Escalate tool or process issues and follow up on non-conformities related to tool behaviour, inspection quality, or data integrity   

Inspection & Process Support 
 
 

• Manage incoming SEM metrology requests and verify their alignment with tool capabilities and process specifications  

• Advise requesters on optimal inspection strategies, including recommending more suitable metrology techniques when appropriate  

• Review and interpret inline SEM/XSEM output, as well as macro- and microscopic wafer inspections; share findings with process engineers and other stakeholders  

• Support timely wafer movement by proactively screening flows and reports (e.g., hold queues, tool down/forecast reports), and contribute to reducing hold times  

• Coordinate inspection reservations and align with stakeholders to minimize cycle time impact, supporting the fab’s overall KPI targets  

• Review and append SEM and FIB signature/authorization requests  

• Share Best Known Methods (BKMs) and documentation templates to support consistent and high-quality inspection output across the team   

Team & Knowledge Sharing 
 
 

• Collaborate with operators, FLS, and engineers to execute daily priorities efficiently and accurately  

• Support training, onboarding, and continuous learning within the team  

• Contribute to knowledge transfer by sharing insights on inspection data interpretation, inspection techniques, and tool behaviour  

Who you are 
 
 

• A bachelor's in chemistry, Physics, Electronics, Electromechanics, or similar industrial experience  

• Eager to learn and self-organized  

• Good sense of urgency and the flexibility to take on tasks in function of project needs  

• Accurate and organized  

• Dedicated to a high standard of quality and work  

• Resilient and problem-solving  

• Independent and proactive  

• Decisive and assertive  

• Good social- and communication skills  

• Proficient English   

We seek a candidate who thrives in a dynamic work environment, showcasing an adaptability to diverse projects or research topics. You’ll be a key team player, ready to support colleagues and tackle impactful projects within the timelines of our trusted global partners.

Fluves is a pioneer in fiber optic sensing, combining advanced DTS and DAS technology, real-time data processing and smart analytics to monitor and protect critical infrastructure.
 

Through its Marlinks product line, Fluves monitors more than 1,800 km of subsea power cables linking offshore wind farms and power grids. The DALI product line detects leaks and intrusions in water networks. Fluves Corrosion assesses the risk of corrosion under insulation in chemical plants.
 

Fluves is a growing international scale-up, active in critical infrastructure markets around the world.
 

Our products handle high-volume DAS/DTS signals. Doing that reliably depends on a IT stack with a set of backend (edge) services that ingest data, orchestrate workloads, expose APIs, and integrate outputs into our application. We are looking for a software engineer to build and evolve this stack, ensuring secure, scalable, and observable processing from field deployments through to client-facing applications.
 

What you will do
 

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated software engineer for the following responsibilities:
 
 

• Take an active role in the development of the edge-server platform, application backend and API integrations. 

• Challenge existing poor architectural patterns constructively and bring structure. Propose, showcase and implement architectural alternatives to improve the computational flow. 

• Actively and continuously improve and modernize existing components, focusing on incremental, high-impact enhancements. 

• Extend the existing monitoring and benchmarks and profile the current code to identify and improve bottle necks. 

• Collaborate closely with colleagues in the product development team to design, build, and continuously improve product features in the edge and application layer, and deliver new integrations with internal, third-party, and client platforms. 

• Document best practices and clarify trade-offs to shorten the time to deployment of new data product features. 

Who you are
 
 

• Holds a degree in computer science or computer engineering, or has equivalent experience. 

• At least 3 years of experience. 

• Professional Python developer with proven experience with backend development in Django, Django restframework, Postgres and Timescaledb. 

• Track record in parallel computing and multiprocessing and/or experience with message brokers, storage backends and task queues (e.g. RabbitMQ, Redis, Celery …). 

• Understanding the limitations of computer hardware (CPU and GPU and disk storage patterns). 

• Knowledge of low-level programming languages and/or GPU architecture. 

• Preferably feels comfortable with scientific Python libraries for array computing such as Numpy and Xarray. 

• Some notion of the frequency domain and Fourier transformation is appreciated. 

• Clear and open communicator striving for clarity with a documentation reflex. 

• Writes unit tests, keeps (sphinx) documentation up to date, knows git and is familiar with CI/CD pipelines. 

• Uses AI tools as a standard part of how you write, review, and reason about code, while remaining accountable for the outcome. 

• Down to earth, hands-on problem solver that likes to take a deep dive into computational challenges. 

• Fluency in English, both spoken and written. Proficiency in one additional language — Dutch, French, or German — is highly desirable, along with strong writing and presentation skills. 

• Current residence in Belgium.
